b: ^Oh, it seems another one has come here to offer themselves up to him.
^This world is a loop, and it will never end as long as he's still here.
^Anyway, I'm just a humble street vendor; what right do I have to judge anyone?

TheSalesman: ^My young friend asked me, "What do you want to buy today?"

c-0: ^I hope you find something good here.

leave_the_store: ^Thank you for visiting, and I wish you good luck on your journey.

b: ^It's great to see you again, my fellow traveler.
^I have some cool stuff for you. Would you like to trade?
^Oh, it seems you own a sigil that's very useful to me. Would you like to trade?

chosen: ^That's a wise choice. Good luck on your journey.
no_choice: ^That's a shame, but I wish you good luck on your journey anyway.

b: ^Hello my friend, it seems you're new here.
^So I think you should get used to some things here.

MysteriousHunter: ^I have a little challenge for you.
^Overcome it, and I will reward you handsomely.

c-0: ^Haha, well done, my friend. Keep trying!
c-1: ^It seems you're still not confident enough.
^Keep practicing, and I'll challenge you again next time.

MysteriousHunter_challenge_end: ^Good job, my friend. Here's a small reward for your efforts.
^Hopefully, these runes will be helpful on your journey.

b: ^Hello, I heard there's a new person here, so it turns out it's you!
^There are so many traps out there. I can't let a newcomer with unknown abilities go out there and throw themselves to their death.

MysteriousHero: ^I have a challenge: catch a BamBear and bring it back here, and I will acknowledge your abilities.

c-1: ^Don't be ashamed for backing down. I understand that in this chaotic world, everyone puts their own life first.
^But always remember to strive to improve your strength so you can protect yourself.

MysteriousHero_challenge_end: ^Well done, brave warrior. This is your reward for your efforts.
TAE: ^Allow me to introduce myself, I am <color=#EEC15F>The Anti-absolute Entity</color>, the one who summoned you from the other side of the universe.
^As you can see, this world is being invaded by monsters everywhere, so we need to summon heroes from the other side of the universe to help us fight against them.
^You, who have proven yourself worthy of the favor of <color=#EEC15F>Quantum Bridge</color>, I hope you will strive to fight with all your might on this journey.
